description: Versioned set of the ONLY claims permitted in any marketing artifact or generated content. Per PRD §8.6 and Principle 9: nothing outside this library is eligible for use. This is the input gate for the content engine.

approved_claims.claim: A writing tool that helps you create demand letters and cancellation emails
permitted_variations: Writing assistance for dispute resolution
Helps you draft demand letters
Creates cancellation emails based on your situation

approved_claims.claim: Researches how similar disputes are typically handled in your jurisdiction
permitted_variations: Surfaces relevant statutes and deadlines for your state
Shows you how people in similar situations typically proceed
prohibited_variations: Analyzes the strength of your claim

approved_claims.claim: Walks you through the dispute process one step at a time
permitted_variations: Guides you from first step to resolution
Step-by-step dispute assistance
Takes you from frustration to action

approved_claims.claim: Generates submission-ready filing packets for your specific court or agency
permitted_variations: Pre-fills court forms for your county
Prepares your filing paperwork

approved_claims.claim: People who send demand letters are more likely to receive a response than those who don't act
permitted_variations: Taking action is the first step toward resolution
Most disputes start with a written demand
prohibited_variations: You will get your money back

approved_claims.claim: Users have reported recovering security deposits and cancelling unwanted subscriptions
approved_claims.conditions: May ONLY be used when backed by a specific, verified, consented testimonial from the testimonial pipeline. The specific outcome must match the claim.
permitted_variations: [Name/Anonymous] reported recovering $X from their deposit dispute
[Name/Anonymous] successfully cancelled their [service] membership
prohibited_variations: Our users always recover their deposits
You'll recover more than you paid

approved_claims.claim: Deposit case: $49 one-time. Subscription cancellation: free.
permitted_variations: Try subscription cancellation for free
Deposit cases start at $49
prohibited_variations: Cheaper than a lawyer (implies we substitute for one)

approved_claims.claim: This is a writing tool, not legal advice. We do not evaluate cases, predict outcomes, or substitute for a licensed attorney.
Security deposit coverage for California, Texas, New York, and Florida
permitted_variations: Deposit letters grounded in [state] law
State-specific deposit statutes for CA, TX, NY, FL
Cancel unwanted subscriptions anywhere in the US
Subscription help for any US state

absolute_prohibitions: Any claim containing 'guarantee', 'guaranteed', or 'promise' in relation to outcomes
Any success percentage, probability, or likelihood claim
Any claim that the tool provides legal advice or substitutes for an attorney
Any claim using 'robot lawyer', 'AI lawyer', 'AI attorney', or similar
Any claim about case strength, leverage, or the merits of a user's position
Any claim that the user 'has a case' or 'is entitled to' a specific outcome
Any claim about what a counterparty will do
Any outcome claim not backed by a specific verified consented testimonial
